description: Use this when the user asks what to make for a campaign, how to start, or what a clip needs: ClippingAlpha's creative plan for one campaign. What to make (how many clips the material supports, the length, vertical or not, the social apps and how that fits TikTok, Reels and Shorts), what to cut it from (ready clips to post as is, or no footage, make your own content), the clips best first grouped by source video (its title, app, length and a summary in our words, then per clip the cut range, what happens there, why it should work from the moment score, a spoken opener and the 9:16 fit, numbered steps to follow and a Watch link to the original public video at that second, a brand file by its number with no link), the brand's short ready clips one card each with every analysed clip counted (post as is or reframe to 9:16, why it works or not, the steps), what to post instead for a logo or music campaign (the niche, where the logo goes, the sound, lyrics on screen, the effort), what every post must include and avoid (tags, mentions, #ad, logo or end card, call to action, banned content) with the brief's own words for each rule, and how to get the footage in the brief's words. Each clip carries its hook idea, labelled as a suggestion, and the hook ideas no clip carries follow. Signed out, the best 3 clips a source. Signed in, a handful of clips a source and the footage password when the brand published one in the brief for clippers. Each clip also carries the ffmpeg command that cuts it, 9:16 at 1080 by 1920, from a file the clipper downloaded themselves. Never a transcript line or a media file. Read only.

campaign.description: The campaign as brand/series (for example lovable/clipping), its clippingalpha.com page URL, or its numeric campaignId from another tool.
